What is he asking for in return? Does he—arrgh!|Domaric Quinn is cut off by Kylo Ren, preventing the Supreme Council from learning of Darth Sidious' demands for Jedi Rey's death|}} '''Domaric Quinn''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[junior officer]] before rising to become a [[general]] and key [[First Order Army|ground forces]] [[commander]] in the [[First Order]]. He was selected to serve as part of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren's]] [[First Order Supreme Council|Supreme Council]], but found it difficult to keep his doubts about Ren's reliance on [[The Force|mysticism]] in check. Despite his prior service in the Empire, he aligned [[Politics|politically]] with the younger generation of First Order personnel: those who wanted to discard what they deemed to be the failings of the prior regime. For that reason, he was dismissive towards the seemingly [[Death|deceased]] [[Galactic Emperor]], [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], whom he regarded as a failure. In [[35 ABY]], it was revealed Palpatine had returned from death, after which Ren formed an alliance with the phantom [[emperor]]. In a subsequent meeting of the Supreme Council on board the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], Quinn questioned Ren on the First Order's allegiance with the [[Sith Eternal]] cult and its fleet, the [[Final Order]], on [[Exegol]]. As Quinn began to question what Palpatine wanted in return for his resources, Ren—who was unwilling to surrender details about the [[Padawan|Jedi-in-training]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], whom he sought to ally with but whom Palpatine ordered dead—cut Quinn off by using the Force to [[Force choke|choke]] the general and slam him into the ceiling, ultimately [[Death|killing]] him. ==Biography== ===Imperial survivor=== {{Quote|Forgive me, sir, but these allies on Exegol, they sound like a cult. Conjurers and soothsayers.''"
"''They've conjured legions of Star Destroyers. The Sith fleet will increase our resources ten thousand fold.|Domaric Quinn and Enric Pryde discuss the Sith fleet|}} [[File:Quinn_supreme_council.png|thumb|left|250px|Domaric Quinn served on the First Order's Supreme Council.]] [[Reproduction|Born]] during the [[Imperial Era]] some point prior to [[5 BBY]], Domaric Quinn was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[junior officer]] of the [[Imperial Officer Corps]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]], serving within its [[Imperial Army]]. After the [[Battle of Jakku|fall]] of the Empire, Quinn was amongst those Imperials who joined the [[First Order]], first continuing to serve as a junior officer, then to the [[military rank]] of [[commander]], and subsequently rose to [[general]], becoming one of its key ground force commanders of the Order. Despite his service in the Imperial Army, Quinn aligned closer to his younger colleagues in the First Order; he hoped to take the best of what the Empire had been but, otherwise, hoped to discard its failings.{{InsiderCite|235|Rise of the First Order (Star Wars Insider)}} General Quinn and his forces benefited greatly from the First Order's ambitious military build-up, at first modest but then more visible as the Order gained more confidence. [[Sonn-Blas Corporation]] and the contributions of trade allies to the First Order, facilities in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories]] produced weapons and munitions for the First Order. As a result, General Quinn and his forces were among the best equipped in [[the galaxy]] as the First Order moved to conquer more territory under the ploy of spreading civilization in the Unknown Regions and the bordering systems of the [[New Republic]]. Quinn served under [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]] until his [[death]] at the [[Battle of Crait]] in [[34 ABY]], after which he came to serve under Snoke's successor, [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]]. When Ren formed a [[First Order Supreme Council]] to help plan the future of the First Order, Quinn was given a seat. In [[35 ABY]], Quinn attended one of the council's meetings on board{{Film|IX}} the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']]. Ren presented the Council with the head of the Resistance sympathizer [[Boolio]] and announced that there was a [[Armitage Hux|traitor]] within their ranks; however, due to the recent discovery of [[Darth Sidious]]' survival on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] and the promise of a [[Final Order|Sith fleet]] to bolster the forces of the First Order, the Supreme Leader was unconcerned. ===Going too far=== {{Quote|Prepare to crush any worlds that defy us. My knights and I are going hunting for the scavenger.|Kylo Ren gives orders as he kills Quinn|}} [[File:Quinn_choke.jpg|thumb|right|250px|General Domaric Quinn was killed by the Supreme Leader for questioning him.]] Quinn then questioned the First Order's partnership with the [[Sith Eternal]] on Exegol, complaining that they were a cult full of nothing but conjurers and soothsayers. Quinn's other superior [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] scoldingly reminded him of the extremely high increase in resources the alliance with the [[Sith]] would provide, but the General persisted and asked Ren what it was that the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] wanted in return for the [[fleet]]. In truth, Sidious did desire something in return, the death of the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], but Ren intended to turn her to the dark side and betray the [[Sith Lord]]. Mid-sentence, Quinn was cut off when Ren used [[the Force]] to begin [[Force choke|choking]] him, before proceeding to [[Telekinesis|slam]] the general into the ceiling of the conference room. Something in Quinn's body fractured loudly upon impact, and Supreme Leader Ren slowly choked the general to [[death]], as he ordered the other [[First Order officer|officers]] present to focus on crushing all remaining resistance to the First Order while he hunted down Rey with the [[Knights of Ren]]. ==Personality and traits== Quinn was a technologist at [[heart]] and used logic-based solutions verified by complex [[computer]] simulations in his battle strategies. When he served in the Galactic Empire, Quinn considered the [[Jedi]] to be a myth, and attributed the stories of [[the Force]] as hearsay, propaganda, and exaggeration, similar to other officers who had never witnessed the powers of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] or [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], the two [[Sith Lord]]s who sat at the top of the Imperial hierarchy.[[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]] Quinn believed in technological superiority above all else. Despite his service in the Empire, he was younger than other Imperial veterans in the First Order, such as Enric Pryde, and, thus, aligned politically with the younger generation in the First Order, those who wanted to discard the failings of the Empire that came before them. For that reason, he was dismissive of Palpatine, whom he regarded as a failed ruler who the First Order needed to evolve past. He disagreed with Snoke's reliance on mysticism, but kept his opinions in check. Under Kylo Ren, the general was frustrated by the fact that the Supreme Leader was more than ten [[Standard year|years]] his junior and struggled to keep his temper under control, questioning Ren openly in front of the Supreme Council about his alliance with the Sith Eternal, who he considered little more than conjurers and soothsayers. His opinion was an outgrowth of his dismissive attitude towards Palpatine, whose failure in the Galactic Civil War left him with the opinion that the Emperor was deserving of no loyalty from the First Order and that he had nothing to offer the new regime. Those beliefs put him at odds with Imperial loyalists like Pryde, who was quick to argue for the alliance. During the exchange, Quinn's voice dripped with contempt. Quinn, as a [[human]] male, had light skin, [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s and black [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Domaric Quinn wore a black [[First Order military uniforms|First Order officer's uniform]] with a black [[belt]], [[boot]]s and [[glove]]s. The left sleeve of his uniform bore the double-banded rank insignia of a general. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|My character was clearly pushing it a bit, I think. Feeling a bit rebellious, and it wasn't for the first time. J.J. suggested it might have been the second or third occasion that Quinn had countered Kylo Ren's orders, and in this occasion, he was feeling a bit annoyed so he pushed things a bit further. Too far. But J.J. didn't want me to shout or get angry. He said to me Quinn was, "still respectful, but you need to challenge [Kylo]," so I knew what to do—be respectful but push it a bit.|Simon Paisley Day|{{InsiderCite|211|A Day to Die For}}}} Domaric Quinn was portrayed by [[Simon Paisley Day]] in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. His surname was revealed in the film's credits, while his forename was first revealed in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. According to Day, the dialogue for his scene had been changed between his rehearsal and the actual filming, with director [[J.J. Abrams]] instructing him to speak to [[Adam Driver]] in a challenging yet respectful tone without shouting or getting visibly angry under the rationale that in-universe, this was likely the second or third time Quinn was countering Kylo Ren's orders. Day told [[Star Wars Insider|''Star Wars'' Insider]] he is proud of his brief role. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation 1|''The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation'' 1]] ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Domaric}} *{{Topps|set=2020 Topps Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Series 2|subset=Villains of the First Order|cardname=General Quinn}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Final Order and the Battle of Exegol}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The First Order}} *{{GoS|Dark Side (episode)}} *{{InsiderCite|211|A Day to Die For}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{InsiderCite|235|Rise of the First Order (Star Wars Insider)}} *{{Databank|general-quinn|General Quinn}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Domaric Quinn |fr=Domaric Quinn |ja=ドマリク・クイン |ka=დომარიკ კუინი |pl=Domaric Quinn}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Quinn, Domaric}} [[Category:First Order admirals and generals]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Supreme Council members]]
